Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff
Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff

Pride and Progress News - highlights: 1. A recap of some of the major LGBT events of 1984. Clips include: 2. Original "Stonewallers" at Pride Parade 3. Bella Abzug speech at Greater Gotham Business Meeting COMMERCIAL: "New York Native" with Quentin Crisp 4. Virginia Apuzzo on LGBT presence at Democratic National Convention 5. VP candidate Geraldine Ferraro at Democratic National Convention on human rights 6. Maureen Reagan, daughter of President, interviewed at Republican National Convention COMMERCIAL: Carnaval in Rio de Janeiro, Islanders' Club 7. Mayor Ed Koch at fundraiser for Judge Bill Thom 8. David Rothenberg campaign speech 10. Speech by Victor Gotbaum, Director DC 37, AFSCME COMMERCIAL: World of Video 11. [Fairpack], a new political gay action committee 12. Reports on AIDS in 1984 COMMERCIAL: Chamberlain and Associates, career service professionals 13. Report on gays on television in 1984, including Showtime's cable series "Brothers" 14. Gay youth 16. Acquisition of NYC's LGBT Community Center on West 13th Street 15. Wrap up of 1984 events COMMERCIAL: Disc-o-rama, NY video and music store 16. Healthline: Conversations with GMHC: Michael Shernoff, Chelsea Psychotherapy, discusses how to deal with friends who have AIDS 17. Closing credits
The Right Stuff: 1. Performance by the Big Apple Corps Band with the Pink Panther COMMERCIAL: "The Gascon," a novel by John Colin Penford 2. Gary Dee, female impersonator, on playing Joan Rivers COMMERCIAL: Disc-o-rama, NY video and music store 3. "Home for the Holidays," benefit at Limelight for AIDS Research Center (ARC), appearances by Whoopi Goldberg, Maurice Hines COMMERCIAL: "The Connection," gay and lesbian newspaper 4. "Impulse," Gat TV in Atlanta COMMERCIAL: World of Video 5. Closing Credits
